proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.item_form
proposed_widenings.justification: The surface can express changing an item's form with `alter_item_kind`, but it cannot honestly gate passive or reaction mechanics on the item's current form.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Acrobatic Assist (Quarterstaff and 10-Foot Pole Forms Only). Attack Deflection (Quarterstaff Form Only). Ranged Weapon (Quarterstaff Form Only).

proposed_widenings.name: emit_light
proposed_widenings.justification: The item has a deterministic light-emission toggle, and no existing effect atom represents creating or extinguishing emitted light.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While holding this weapon, you can cause it to emit green Dim Light out to 10 feet ... or you can extinguish the light as a Bonus Action.

proposed_widenings.name: grant_weapon_property
proposed_widenings.justification: The item temporarily gives the quarterstaff the Thrown property in one form, and the current authored surface has no runtime weapon-property grant effect.
proposed_widenings.evidence: This weapon has the Thrown property with a normal range of 30 feet and a long range of 120 feet.

proposed_widenings.name: return_item_after_ranged_attack
proposed_widenings.justification: The weapon automatically returns to the wielder's hand after a specific attack event, which is neither a passive numeric modifier nor an existing activation/reaction effect.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Immediately after you make a ranged attack with the weapon, it flies back to your hand.

notes: Top-level fit would otherwise be a composite magic item, but the unit cannot be authored honestly without form-state gating plus new atoms for emitted light and the thrown/returning weapon rider. No content/tracer files were produced.
